characterSubjects.jonathan: Young English solicitor Jonathan Harker, earnest and travel-worn, neat dark hair and moustache, practical tweed suit.
characterSubjects.dracula: Count Dracula as Harker first sees him: tall elderly Transylvanian nobleman, long white moustache, aquiline nose, pointed ears, red lips and severe black clothes; no cape or screen likeness.
characterSubjects.mina: Mina Murray Harker, intelligent young schoolmistress and typist, composed gaze, pinned auburn-brown hair and modest high-collared dress.
characterSubjects.lucy: Lucy Westenra, warm young gentlewoman with softly curled fair hair and an elegant pale day dress, lively but vulnerable.
characterSubjects.seward: Dr John Seward, serious young asylum physician, dark three-piece suit, restrained moustache, phonograph cylinder case as a subtle contextual prop.
characterSubjects.van-helsing: Professor Abraham Van Helsing, older Dutch scholar-physician, broad brow, swept grey hair, moustache and pointed beard, travel-worn dark coat.
characterSubjects.arthur: Arthur Holmwood, young English aristocrat, dignified and grieving, tailored dark frock coat.
characterSubjects.quincey: Quincey P. Morris, capable Texan gentleman, sun-weathered face, neat moustache, period travelling coat; no cowboy caricature.
characterSubjects.renfield: R. M. Renfield, gaunt middle-aged asylum patient with intense intelligent eyes, disordered hair, worn waistcoat and shirt; humane, not monstrous.
characterSubjects.mrs-westenra: Mrs Westenra, frail widowed Victorian gentlewoman, dignified older face, dark formal dress and lace collar.
characterSubjects.hawkins: Peter Hawkins, elderly Exeter solicitor, kind lined face, spectacles, conservative black office coat.
characterSubjects.sister-agatha: Sister Agatha, compassionate hospital nun in Budapest, mature calm face and historically plausible black-and-white habit.
characterSubjects.three-women: Exactly three distinct aristocratic vampire women together in a candlelit castle chamber, alluring and predatory, period gowns, no gore.
characterSubjects.captain: Captain of the Demeter, weather-beaten Russian sea captain with grey beard, oilskin and naval cap, steadfast at the wheel.
characterSubjects.mate: First Mate of the Demeter, broad weathered sailor, anxious hard stare, wool coat and cap.
characterSubjects.swales: Mr Swales, very old Whitby sailor, wiry face, white whiskers, knitted cap and heavy coat, seated near the churchyard cliff.
characterSubjects.bilder: Thomas Bilder, sturdy Victorian zookeeper, practical waistcoat and rolled sleeves, calm professional expression.
characterSubjects.bersicker: Bersicker, a massive naturalistic grey zoo wolf with intelligent amber eyes, Victorian iron enclosure suggested behind him.
characterSubjects.attendant: Seward's unnamed male asylum attendant, capable working man in plain waistcoat and rolled sleeves, alert but humane.
characterSubjects.billington: Samuel F. Billington, respectable Whitby shipping solicitor, side-whiskers, dark suit, maritime office background.
characterSubjects.snelling: Thomas Snelling, rough but honest London carter, weathered face, cap, neckerchief and work coat.
characterSubjects.hildesheim: Immanuel Hildesheim, efficient Galatz shipping agent, middle-aged, neatly groomed, dark continental business suit.
characterSubjects.skinsky: Petrof Skinsky, broad-shouldered Slovak transporter in practical 1890s river-port clothing, guarded expression.
characterSubjects.donelson: Captain Donelson of the Czarina Catherine, seasoned English merchant captain, naval coat and cap, composed authority.
characterSubjects.szgany: A respectful group portrait of six rugged Szgany retainers escorting an earth-filled crate through a Carpathian pass; individualized faces, historically plausible rural clothing, no caricature.

itemSubjects.bowie: Quincey's substantial clip-point Bowie knife with wooden grip and leather sheath on worn travelling gear.
